entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manvendra Singh
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record.
None has appeared on behalf of informant despite taking the case in revised list.

2. The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 623 of 2022, under Sections - 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station - Kalan,
District - Shahjahanpur, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

It was submitted that first information report was lodged by the Ranjeet Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26866966/
1 informant on 31.12.2022, alleging that on the night of 23.12.2022 applicant and co-accused persons have enticed away his sister, aged 12 years.

entities.text: Ranjeet Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that alleged incident has been shown of 23.12.2022 but first information report has been lodged after 8 days on 31.12.2022.
It was stated that even no missing report was lodged after the victim has gone from her house.
As per statement of victim, she was taken to Haridwar, Budaun and later to Haryana but she has never raised any alarm nor made any complaint.
It is submitted that first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 29.05.2023 and after that statement of victim girl has been recorded before the Trial Court.
In her statement recorded before the Trial Court, she has inter alia stated that her age is 21 years and that she has not sustained any injury.
As per ossification test report, age of victim was 17 years and thus, by giving a margin of two years on upper side she has to be treated as a major girl.
Applicant is in jail since 24.01.2023 and the victim has already been examined and thus, there is no possibility of tampering with evidence.
Lastly, it was stated that applicant has no criminal history and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application and submitted that as per school record, the age of victim is 16 years and she has made allegations of rape against the applicant.
It was submitted that first bail application of applicant has already been rejected on merits.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the present second bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant - Ranjeet Yadav involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 12.11.2024 SK Srivastava  Ranjeet Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26866966/
